# Stubprint

> A thermal printer simulator for development and testing. It reads ESC/POS, Star Line and StarPRNT like a real receipt printer, and shows what came out as a picture of the paper, as text, or as the list of commands with their bytes. It comes as one program with a web app and a CLI.

Programs print to its TCP ports (127.0.0.1:9100 by default) exactly as they would to a network printer. `stubprint wait` waits for the next receipt and exits 0 when one came, which is how a test or an agent checks what was printed. The same data is available over an HTTP API described by an OpenAPI document at `/api/openapi.json` of a running server.

Install on macOS and Linux with `curl -fsSL https://stubprint.dev/install.sh | sh`, and on Windows with `irm https://stubprint.dev/install.ps1 | iex`. A version goes in the address: `https://stubprint.dev/<version>/install.sh`.

## Docs

- [Command line](https://github.com/Wadiou/stubprint/blob/main/docs/CLI.md): every command, the options and the exit codes
- [Server](https://github.com/Wadiou/stubprint/blob/main/docs/SERVER.md): printers, what a printer does, the API and live events

## Reference

- [ESC/POS](https://github.com/Wadiou/stubprint/blob/main/docs/reference/ESCPOS.md): which commands are read, and what is left out
- [Star Line and StarPRNT](https://github.com/Wadiou/stubprint/blob/main/docs/reference/STAR.md): the same for the Star languages
